title: Warm Peruvian Banana Skewers with Spiced Italian Glaze
description: A fusion of Peruvian and Italian flavors, these banana skewers are marinated in a warm spice blend and grilled to perfection, served with a sweet and sticky Italian glaze.
instructions: 2. Cut bananas into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers.
3. In a small bowl, mix together warmly spiced peruvian seasoning, honey, lemon juice, melted butter, powdered sugar, and italian lemon zest.
4. Brush the Peruvian spice mixture onto the banana skewers.
5. Grill banana skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until caramelized and tender.
6. Serve warm banana skewers drizzled with additional Italian glaze, if desired.
